project: Finite Automata for Real-Time Input Validation
alphabet_convention: ASCII classes are specified per model; inputs outside a model's language transition to a rejecting/dead configuration.

password_policy.state: Direct product state (n, upper, lower, digit, special): n is length capped at 8 and each flag records whether that category has appeared; equivalent to (n,m) with a 4-bit mask
password_policy.acceptance: end of input with n=8 and m=15
password_policy.construction: Direct product of five component DFAs: one capped length counter and four seen/not-seen category recognizers
password_policy.transition: advance n up to 8; each category component changes from false to true when matched and then stays true

email_subset.type: NFA, then subset-construction DFA, then minimized DFA
email_subset.accepted_language: alnum+ ( [._-] alnum+ )* @ label ( . label )* . letter{2,}; label = alnum+ ( - alnum+ )*
email_subset.nondeterministic_choice: On a dot after a domain label, continue the domain or guess that the final suffix begins here.

four_digit_pin.transition: ASCII digit advances q0→q1→q2→q3→q4; any other input, or any input after q4, goes to dead; dead loops.

three_strike_session.type: DFA over events C (correct) and W (wrong)
three_strike_session.transition: W advances toward LOCKED; C resets to READY; LOCKED is absorbing.
